newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to trade options on Alberto-Culver Class A.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to trade options on Alberto-Culver Class A.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Tuesday it will list options on Class A shares of Alberto-Culver Co on June 6.
The exchange said the options will have opening strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30 and introductory expirations in June, July, October and January.
Options Resource Group has been named the designated primary market maker for the options, the CBOE said.
Options on regular Alberto-Culver shares began trading at the CBOE and the American Stock Exchange on Monday.
